title: tiller-book plan
description: One plan per unit, stored as plans/<id>.toml. A unit writes only inside allowed_paths.

allowed_paths.description: Relative POSIX paths. An entry ending in / is a directory prefix; any other entry is one exact file. No globs, no '..', no leading /.

min_held_out_cases.description: Minimum held-out cases for a measurement; the v0.1 default is 20. v0.1 records it and runs no measurement.

model_calls.description: Names of the model calls the unit may make. A call not listed stops the unit for the owner.
